name: File Compressor Button
description: Button that plays a file compression animation on click: paper sheets drop in, the button folds, a zipper runs across it, and the label swaps to a checkmark.
contents: Single button with label, three paper sheets, zipper and checkmark
behavior: Click starts the compression animation, ignored while it runs
Button folds and a zipper slides across, then a checkmark appears
Returns to idle after the duration
Hover darkens the button, press scales it down
editableByProps: Idle and completed labels, button width, animation reset time
All button, paper, zipper and text colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Run a callback or real compression on click
Change the number or position of paper sheets
needsCodeEdit.where: The three paper divs using animate-paper-run

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Animation timings are fixed in the keyframes and assume a duration of at least 3.5s
